themes.title: Global political economy
themes.text: How governments and industrial policy reshape the markets that firms operate in

about:
Hi! I am Bryan, an Economics PhD student at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore. I'm interested in global markets such as why prices move, how trade flows shift, and how politics changes both.

Before the PhD I spent two years at S&P Global as a price assessment specialist, covering movements in commodity prices. I spoke with traders and producers across Asia every day and wrote daily reports explaining the movements of prices. Earlier, I worked in strategy and market research at Kantar Consulting, Jacaranda Capital Partners and FairPrice Group.

Here, I share my thoughts and opinions regarding economic matters.

contact.intro: I'm always happy to talk about markets, trade, or anything under the sun! You may reach out to me on my email or LinkedIn
